item.title: Muskingum County Prosecutor’s Office releases their annual report for 2025
item.description: ZANESVILLE, Ohio – Muskingum County Prosecutor Ron Welch has announced a new annual report initiative and released the 2025 annual report in a press release last week. The report was released on February 9th and shows high-profile convictions and community outreach efforts that took place in 2025.
